evidenceBasis: Synthesis of 17 production-truth artifacts (funnel, business truth, teacher growth forensic, investor power users, school analysis, commission E2E, founder identity/role, metric & business dictionaries). All numbers read-only from production Supabase.

PROVEN: AI tools are the #1 magnet for teachers: 73 teachers adopted an AI feature; aiTeachersLast30 = 44; bc-assistant 139 calls/33 teachers; rpp 52 calls/28 teachers.
A specific teacher archetype exists that creates a class AND drives student activity: ~10 teachers hold 50+ students, artifact-heavy teachers drive 54-97% student XP-activation vs ~30% passive.
Playbook A 'Class Operator' works: Dorothea (169 st, 6 penugasan, 9 quiz, 91 XP-active), Ibrahim (117 st, 117 XP-active in 30d, 6 quiz), Elli (57 st, 5 penugasan, 3 quiz, 13 quiz submissions).
Playbook B 'Literasi Publisher' works: Karina (155 st, 149 XP, 131 karya), Christanti (59 st, 56 XP, 48 karya), Wahyu Kristanti (36 st, 32 karya).
Commission system is wired end-to-end and safe: zero commissions are a DATA GAP (no student in a non-founder class ever purchased premium), not a logic bug.
STRONG_SIGNAL: Premium funnel exists but is minuscule: 4/465 trials converted (0.86%); accomplished revenue Rp438,000 (~US$29) total, pre-revenue.
Feature adoption decouples from classroom creation: AI (73) >> Quiz (15) > Penugasan (8) > Karya feedback (5) > Pengumuman (2) > Game (1) > Nilai (0).
Login activity shows real base: 7d=634, 30d=1,342, 90d=1,854 logins with 583 never-active (of 2,437 users).
Students respond to teacher activation: artifact-heavy classrooms produce 54-97% student XP-activation.
PROMISING_BUT_UNPROVEN: School/GTM effect: 0 canonical schools, 683 unique raw school names, dominant santa-laurensia + al-fityan + harapan-bangsa clusters; school motion latent and unmeasurable today.
Student retention / repeat usage curve not established (no clean cohort retention D7/D30 published for learners).
WEAK: Classroom creation: only 54/484 GURU (11.2%) created a class; only 8 (1.7%) ever produced a teaching artifact.
Teacher activation rate: only 2 active teachers in 30d; activeRateOfCreators = 3.7%; ~430 GURU are trial 'pelamar' who never made a class.
Teacher tenure retention: F_teacherRetention shows long activation-gap (many firstGroup without firstAction).
Game host adoption: only 1 teacher hosted a game; game server dead (VPS).
NEGATIVE_SIGNAL: 108 orphan groups (created, zero artifacts, zero activity).
Top groups lean founder-concentrated: 3 founders hold ~32% of grouped students (Alexander ~180, Dominikus ~133, Washadi ~90).
2,050 phantom student profiles without canonical schoolId.
Empty/zero-row tables: DailyAction, ActivityLog, LoginHistory, quizzesTaken, TTS.
NOT_YET_MEASURABLE: Unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback) — no paid acquisition running.
Marketing funnel top (premium_viewed, checkout_abandoned) — no instrumentation.
School-level revenue / deal size / sales motion.
Commission payout actually realized (0 to date).
DATA_QUALITY_GAP: GURU count drifts across snapshots: teacher growth forensic 2026-09-03 = 484 > investor production truth 2026-09-02 = 481 > business truth 2026-09-01 = 477. AUTHORITATIVE = 484 (forensic, most recent); drift is due to new signups + founder role remap (founders ADMIN->GURU).
School identity unresolved: 0 canonical schools, 683 raw names, phantom profiles block school-level analytics.
Admin role resolves inconsistently: investor funnel shows 0 ADMIN (founders remapped to GURU) vs business truth 3 ADMIN.
Online/offline session tracking incomplete (no LoginHistory rows despite loginActivity aggregates).

customerHypothesis.icp: The 'operational teacher' — an active Bahasa Indonesia subject teacher (SMP/SMA) who values running a real classroom on the platform: creating one or more class groups, assigning penugasan and quizzes, and seeing students engage.
customerHypothesis.evidence: Only teachers who created a class AND produced teaching artifacts drove meaningful student activity (Playbook A/B, 54-97% XP-activation). The 11.2% who create a class are the measurable core; the other ~89% of signups (trial window-shoppers) never activated.
customerHypothesis.antiIcp: Trial 'pelamar' who register, get AI trial, and never create a class (the ~430 inactive GURU). AI is a magnet but does NOT route to classroom — it is a separate loop.
customerHypothesis.customerMoat: Once a teacher has live students (groups + assignments + submissions), switching cost rises; the 'operational classroom' is the retention and network moat, not the AI tools.

teacherGrowthThesis.equation: Activations = (Teachers who create a class) × (Classrooms with teaching artifacts) × (Students who respond)
teacherGrowthThesis.magnetTension: AI adoption (73) is 9x classroom creation (8) — the biggest funnel is the LEAST monetizable and least retention-bearing surface.
teacherGrowthThesis.reinforcingLoop_target: Move teachers from 'trial AI user' to 'operational classroom operator' by making the first class + first assignment + first student-visible activity the primary success moment ('Aha'), turning the AI-heavy funnel into a classroom-heavy funnel.
teacherGrowthThesis.correlation: students30d and XP-activation rise only where a teacher produced artifacts (penugasan/quiz/karya) — artifact production is the leading indicator.

schoolEffect.evidence: 0 canonical schools; 683 unique raw school names; 2,050 phantom profiles without canonical schoolId; santa-laurensia (204+158+96+88), al-fityan (49+21+17), harapan-bangsa (41+36+23+31) clusters dominate.
schoolEffect.implication: No school-level GTM, no school deal-size metric, no per-school revenue is currently computable. School motion must wait until school identity (Phase P1-C backfill) is resolved.
schoolEffect.recommendation: Do NOT pitch 'school penetration' to investors — it is unmeasurable today. Resolve school identity first, then report school-level cohorts.

pmfSignalMap.retention: WEAK — no clean learner retention curve; 583 never-active users; 108 orphan groups; only 2 active teachers 30d.
pmfSignalMap.activation: PROVEN for artifact-heavy classrooms; WEAK overall (1.7% ever-taught).
pmfSignalMap.growth: NOT MEASURABLE — no paid acquisition, no viral coefficient measured, no organic loop quantified (though classroom spread via student email invites exists anecdotally).
pmfSignalMap.revenue: NEGATIVE_SIGNAL as a company today (pre-revenue), but the reservation is real (premiumActive=4 PRO).
pmfSignalMap.verdict: NOT PMF. Evidence shows a functional, loved-by-a-niche product (artifact teachers) but the activation and monetization loops are too small and too fragmented to claim product-market fit.

MURID_PREMIUM.note: student; 3 buyers all in founder/ADMIN classes (commission-excluded)

monetizationReality.verdict: Waiting on the first non-founder-class MURID_PREMIUM purchase to trigger the first-ever commission and prove the affiliate loop; product is pre-revenue and cannot yet fund acquisition.

primaryBottleneck: ACTIVATION (teacher → operational classroom) — the conversion of 484 registered GURU into the 8 who actually teach is the single biggest gap. Only 11.2% create a class; 1.7% teach. Everything else (retention, monetization, school GTM) is downstream of solving this.

initiatives: Instrument checkout + activation funnel (premium_viewed, checkout_abandoned, class_created, artifact_created) so every loop is measurable.
Ship the 'operational teacher' onboarding: force a first class + first artifact (penugasan OR bank-soal quiz OR karya prompt) inside 10 minutes of signup.
Route AI-tool users (the 73-magnet) into classroom creation with post-generation CTAs ('Kirim hasil ini ke kelas Anda').
days0_30.successThreshold: class-creation rate moves from 11% toward 20%; artifact teachers from 8 toward 15.
days0_30.killRule: If classroom creation does not move after 30d, pivot onboarding flow (not the AI tools).

initiatives: Resolve school identity (apply P1-C backfill policy CASE A/B/C after founder approval) to unlock school-level cohorts.
Launch one repeatable non-founder activation experiment at scale (nudge top artifact teachers to replicate Playbook A/B).
Ship the first clean learner-retention D7/D30 cohort report.
days31_60.successThreshold: schoolId coverage > 0% and first school-cohort report; 2+ new non-founder operational teachers from nudge experiments.
days31_60.killRule: If no non-founder teacher scales an artifact playbook, de-prioritize teacher-led replication and test a school-centric model.

initiatives: Gate first commission: enable a non-founder-class MURID_PREMIUM purchase path and verify the affiliate/commission loop pays out.
Decide product/market direction: classroom-operator-led (B) vs school-led (C) based on days 0-60 evidence.
Prepare investor narrative v2 with real retention + activation + monetization curves for a financing round.
days61_90.successThreshold: first non-founder commission realized; a defensible 90d activation & retention curve printed; a clear monetization-repeatability signal.
days61_90.killRule: If monetization remains zero and retention flat, recommend founder to NOT seek outside capital and instead focus on a paid pilot with 1-2 partner schools.

priorityExperiment.name: OPERATIONAL TEACHER EXPERIMENT
priorityExperiment.hypothesis: If a newly-registered teacher is taken to a working classroom (create class → create first artifact → activate 5+ students) within one session, then the class-creation rate rises from 11% to >=25% and teacher 30d activation rises from 0.4% to >=3%.
priorityExperiment.cohort: New GURU registrations (post-launch date) not already exposed to the treatment.
priorityExperiment.control: Historical / holdout group using the current signup flow.
priorityExperiment.intervention: Guided 'operational teacher' onboarding flow + post-AI CTA routing to classroom.

metrics.primary: teacher 30d activation rate (teacher created class + artifact + >=1 student active)

priorityExperiment.source: synthetic controlled rollout vs current-funnel baseline (privacy-safe, no production mutation)

northStarMetric.name: Operational Classrooms (Active Teacher-Classrooms)
northStarMetric.formula: Count of distinct (groupId) with a GROUP that (a) belongs to a non-founder GURU, (b) has >=1 teaching artifact (penugasan OR bank-soal quiz OR karya-feedback event), and (c) has >=1 student XP event in the trailing 30 days.
northStarMetric.source: production DB (Group + artifacts + GameResult/XpLedger XpTransaction + Penugasan/QuizAssignment/Karya tables)
northStarMetric.rationale: It is the single metric that ties teacher activation, artifact production, and student response into one number, and is the leading indicator for retention and monetization.

investorNarrative.title: Bahasa Indonesia classroom platform with a proven artifact-driven activation loop, pre-revenue, now proving repeatability before raising.
investorNarrative.problem: Indonesian teachers lack a digital home for running live Bahasa Indonesia classrooms; current digital classrooms ignore the subject's writing/literacy/assessment needs.
investorNarrative.solution: One platform where teachers run classes (penugasan, bank-soal quizzes, karya/literacy publishing) AND students get a gamified learning path (Jalur Cerdas, XP/rank, Karya feed) AND assessments (UKBI/TKA sims) AND AI teaching tools.
investorNarrative.traction: 2,437+ users (484 GURU authoritative), 1,254 grouped students, 54 class creators, artifact-driven classrooms with 54-97% student XP-activation, 444+ UKBI certificates, 1,590+ Karya, functional (if latent) commission + monetization rails.
investorNarrative.proofOfLoop: Playbook A+B teachers prove the activation→student-response→retention loop works for the niche.
investorNarrative.honesty: Pre-revenue Rp438k (~US$29); 0.86% trial-to-paid; only 1.7% of teachers ever-taught; school effect unmeasurable today.
investorNarrative.differentiation: Subject-specific (Bahasa Indonesia) depth + integrated literacy/karya + AI tools + gamification + UKBI/TKA — not a generic classroom LMS.
investorNarrative.market: No inflated TAM: start with the operational-teacher niche (hundreds today, thousands addressable via MGMP/KKG networks), expand to school segment only once school identity and a lead product are proven.
investorNarrative.unitEconomics: Not stable enough to quote CAC/LTV yet; monetization rails exist (Pro subscriptions, karya marketplace, student premium, commission) but need the activation bottleneck solved to mean anything.
investorNarrative.ask: Do not raise a growth round yet. Proof-point round / pilot capital only, OR delay raising until the OPERATIONAL TEACHER EXPERIMENT prints real activation + monetization curves.
investorNarrative.riskHonesty: Biggest risk is activation (teacher→classroom→student); second is monetization repeatability; third is founder concentration (3 founders hold ~32% of grouped students).
investorNarrative.northStar: Operational Classrooms (active teacher-classrooms, 30d) as the single number that must grow.

capitalStrategy.recommendation: DO NOT RAISE A BROAD GROWTH ROUND NOW — product is pre-revenue and activation is unsolved.

options.A: Bootstrapped pilot (recommended): run OPERATIONAL TEACHER EXPERIMENT + first commission with 1-2 partner schools using current funds; delay external capital until activation + monetization print real curves. Capital need: ~Rp0-50M operational.
options.B: Small proof-point round (Rp0.5-1B) with milestone tranches tied to activation/retention/monetization numbers — only if a warm investor asks specifically.
options.C: Founder-funded pilot: no dilution, fastest to evidence, keeps optionality.
options.D: Full seed round (Rp4B+): NOT recommended at this stage — no repeatability evidence to justify valuation, and founder concentration + pre-revenue make terms poor.

capitalStrategy.founderVerdictCapital: Pursue A/C (no or minimal dilution) for the next 60-90 days; revisit D only after the experiment + first-commission gate prints.

dataQuality.readOnlyGuarantee: NO production data modified; NO migration; NO fabricated metrics.

whatWeKnow: AI tools are the #1 acquisition magnet but do not route to classroom (activation bottleneck).
A specific 'operational teacher' archetype works: those who create a class + artifacts drive 54-97% student XP-activation.
Two repeatable playbooks exist (Class Operator, Literasi Publisher) proven by non-founder teachers.
Commission + monetization rails are functional and safe; zero commissions are a data gap (no non-founder purchase).
The product is pre-revenue (Rp438k / ~US$29) with strong differentiation depth but unsolved activation.
whatWeBelieve: Routing the AI-magnet funnel into classroom creation is the highest-leverage move for the next 30-90 days.
School effect is real but latent and unmeasurable until school identity is resolved.
Founder concentration (~32% of grouped students in 3 founder classes) is a credibility + growth risk to address.
Monetization repeats only after an activated non-founder classroom produces a paying student.
whatWeDoNOTKnow: Whether class-creation rate can be pushed from 11% to 25%+ (unproven intervention).
Clean learner retention (D7/D30) — no cohort curve yet.
Whether any non-founder teacher can produce a paying student / first commission.
School deal size and whether schools will pay (school identity + pilot unproven).
founderVerdict.singleThingToProve: That a non-founder teacher can repeatedly become an 'operational classroom' (create class → artifact → activate 5+ students → retain), and that this loop triggers first monetization (student premium / commission).
founderVerdict.ninetyDayMission: Raise class-creation rate from 11% to >=25%, grow active teacher-classrooms from ~2 to >=15, resolve school identity for school cohorts, print a clean D7/D30 learner + teacher retention curve, and trigger the first non-founder commission.
founderVerdict.fundraisingStatusRationale: Pre-revenue, activation unsolved, no retention curve, no repeatable monetization, founder concentration. Pursuing capital now would yield poor terms and distract from the one experiment that can change the numbers.
founderVerdict.nextMove: Execute the OPERATIONAL TEACHER EXPERIMENT (days 0-30), instrument the funnel, resolve school identity (days 31-60), and trigger first non-founder commission (days 61-90). Re-score readiness at day 90; only then revisit the capital decision.
